deployment_items.description: Provisions infrastructure through HCP Terraform's no-code provisioning workflow: creates a dedicated workspace from the pinned no-code module, sets the workspace variables from the form's Module Variables panel, adopts the auto-queued run, and pauses the job for human plan review before any apply. 'Continue Job' approves and applies the plan; canceling the job rejects it and discards the TFC run.
deployment_items.name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module

description: Provisions infrastructure from a pinned HCP Terraform no-code module in a dedicated workspace per deployment, with a plan-approval pause before apply.
name: HCP Terraform No-Code Module

teardown_items.description: Destroys the deployment's infrastructure via an auto-confirmed TFC destroy run, then deletes its dedicated workspace via the safe-delete endpoint. Idempotent and PROVFAILED-tolerant: a missing or already-deleted workspace is a warning, not a failure.
teardown_items.name: Teardown HCP Terraform No-Code Module
